headline: Romualdez Files Supplemental Ombudsman Counter-Affidavit with 25 Sworn Statements
seoTitle: Romualdez Files Counter-Affidavit with 25 Sworn Statements | FMB News
seoDescription: Former Speaker Martin Romualdez filed a supplemental counter-affidavit before the Ombudsman with 25 sworn statements disputing cash-delivery allegations.
deck: The former Speaker's legal team submitted additional sworn statements disputing allegations in the ongoing Ombudsman inquiry.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez filed a supplemental counter-affidavit before the Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday, according to the approved FMB News package.

The filing included 25 notarized sworn statements from former drivers, security aides and administrative personnel connected to former representative Zaldy Co, which Romualdez's legal team says contradict cash-delivery allegations attributed to the so-called 'Maleta Boys.'

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Romualdez's counsel, Ade Fajardo, said the submission forms part of the defense in an ongoing preliminary investigation. The package also reports that the filing referenced a retraction attributed to Orly Guteza.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The filing adds competing sworn accounts to a politically sensitive investigation. Those statements are evidence submitted by the defense and should not be treated as an Ombudsman finding on the merits.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The next significant development will be how the Ombudsman evaluates the competing affidavits and whether it seeks further submissions, clarificatory hearings or other investigative steps.
